productHelp:
Usage: pandoc -f FORMAT -t FORMAT [OPTIONS] [FILE|- ...]
--from/-f --to/-t --output/-o PATH (use - for stdout) --yes --standalone/-s --wrap=none
--metadata/-M KEY=VALUE --metadata-file FILE.json --lossy --fail-if-warnings
--resource-path DIR[:DIR] --extract-media DIR --raw-content=reject|escape|retain
--pdf-page-size a4|letter --pdf-orientation portrait|landscape --pdf-margin POINTS
--pdf-font FAMILY|PATH --pdf-font-size POINTS --pdf-line-height MULTIPLIER
PDF families: mono bundled; serif/sans unavailable (E_CAPABILITY). Font paths use only the admitted VFS.
--epub-title TEXT --epub-language TEXT --epub-identifier TEXT --epub-chapter-level 1..6
--list-input-formats --list-output-formats --list-extensions FORMAT --help/-h --version
Use -- before literal filenames. No external PDF engines, ambient fonts, filters or network fetching.
Capabilities (available directions):
Input formats:
commonmark
csv
epub
gfm
html
json
latex
pptx
rst
rtf
tsv
Output formats:
commonmark
epub
epub3
gfm
html
html5
json
latex
pdf
plain
pptx
rst
rtf
normalization: None. Table enum tuple fields projected losslessly from internal enum strings to native JSON enum constructors. No IDs, spans, content, ordering, links or warnings changed.
